title: The MicroFreak: open-source oscillators and a MatrixBrute matrix in a small hybrid
intro: Arturia released the MicroFreak in 2019: a small hybrid synth with one digital oscillator and an analog filter. Seven of its twelve oscillator models use code from Mutable Instruments’ Plaits, a Eurorack module whose code is published under the MIT licence, beside five of Arturia’s own. Its modulation matrix comes from Arturia’s MatrixBrute, and its keyboard is a flat capacitive plate that senses pressure. Firmware updates since have added ten more oscillator types.

timeline.name: Arturia MiniBrute
timeline.text: A 25-key analogue monosynth with one oscillator and a Steiner-Parker filter, the start of Arturia’s analogue hardware after its software instruments.

timeline.name: Arturia MatrixBrute
timeline.text: An analogue monosynth built around a modulation matrix of lit buttons, the idea the MicroFreak’s five-by-seven matrix comes from.

timeline.name: Mutable Instruments Plaits
timeline.text: A Eurorack macro-oscillator whose models are each played by Harmonics, Timbre and Morph; seven of the MicroFreak’s models use its code, the three knobs becoming Wave, Timbre and Shape.

timeline.name: Arturia MicroFreak
timeline.text: One digital oscillator in twelve models, an analog 12 dB filter, four-voice paraphony, a cycling envelope, a 5 × 7 matrix, an arpeggiator and sequencer, and a 25-key touch keyboard.

timeline.name: MicroFreak firmware 2 to 5
timeline.text: New oscillator types (noise, a vocoder, three from Noise Engineering, user wavetables, samples and three granular ones, 22 in all), Chord Mode, scale quantising and four-voice unison.

relatives.name: Arturia MicroFreak Vocoder Edition
relatives.text: The MicroFreak sold with a microphone, for the vocoder oscillator that firmware 2.1 added.

relatives.name: Arturia MiniFreak
relatives.text: The follow-up: six voices of polyphony, more functions and a larger conventional keyboard.

relatives.name: Arturia MatrixBrute
relatives.text: The analogue monosynth whose modulation matrix the MicroFreak’s is modelled on.
